Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class PrivacyStatus

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.PrivacyStatus
public final class PrivacyStatus extends Object
Private (Tor) mode formatting for the 2D taskbar indicator.

Like NetworkStatus, the classification and formatting are pure (glyph(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.TorPrivateMode.State), label(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.TorPrivateMode.State), visible(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.TorPrivateMode.State)) and unit-tested; the live reading is just TorPrivateMode.state(), which is an in-memory read with no process and no I/O. The indicator hides itself while the mode is off, exactly as the battery indicator hides on a host without a battery, so the cluster only carries the shield when an anonymity guarantee is actually in force - and shows a loud Tor !! glyph the moment it is cut.
